# UGConnect

UGConnect is a platform for brands and marketing agencies in Peru to manage UGC creator campaigns, from creator discovery to campaign tracking, deliverables, payments, and performance.

## Useful Links

- [UGConnect landing page](https://ugconnect.pe/)

- [Brand and agency terms](https://ugconnect.pe/legal/terminos-marcas-agencias-ugconnect.html)
- [UGConnect platform](https://app.ugconnect.pe/)
